replicated_originals.reference: Höglinger et al. / PSP Genetics Study Group (2011) Identification of common variants influencing risk of the tauopathy progressive supranuclear palsy

A.reason: Ref [7], the original PSP GWAS: the paper genotypes its top SNPs (P<1E-4) in a new cohort of 533 pathology-confirmed PSP cases and 1172 controls, validating the MAPT, MOBP, EIF2AK3 and STX6 associations.

B.reason: This is a generic Neuro-Ophthalmology textbook chapter on PSP. It does not appear in the paper's reference list and is not a study the paper replicates; most likely a mis-resolved match on the disease name.

notes: Replication-plus-meta-analysis of the 2011 PSP GWAS. The new loci (SLCO1A2, DUSP10) were sub-threshold in the original, so they are novel findings and not replications.
